summary: A long running injury practice with a strong call to action is a strength, but a missing form and stale proof appear to cost you new claims.

findings.problem: The contact area appears to show only a confirmation message, 'Your inquiry is important to us and we will reach out to you shortly', twice, with no visible form fields.
findings.cost: An injured person who wants to enquire cannot leave their details.
findings.fix: A short working claim form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The Head Office heading appears to have no address under it, and the testimonials area appears to show 'Loading...'.
findings.cost: A missing address and stuck reviews remove two key trust signals.
findings.fix: Full address with map and live reviews.

findings.problem: Statistics appear to be from 2018 ('in the year 2018 alone') while the footer reads 2026, and the same paragraph about approachability appears in two sections.
findings.cost: Old numbers and repeated copy make the firm look inactive.

findings.problem: The logo alt text appears to read 'Dont Put it Fff Call SOKOLOFF', phone numbers appear in three formats, and the motorcycle service is named two ways with different URLs.
findings.cost: Typos and mixed formats weaken polish and search visibility.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one phone format.
